name: collab-office
description: 企业协同与事务管理平台（Enterprise Collaboration & Office Management Platform）

scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm exec tsx watch app/backend/src/server.ts
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm exec vite --config app/frontend/vite.config.ts
scripts.build: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm run build:api && pnpm run build:web
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.backend-test.json --noEmit && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.frontend.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.api.config.ts && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.web.config.ts
scripts.test:coverage:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm exec vitest run --config vitest.api.config.ts --coverage
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm run test:coverage:api && pnpm run test:coverage:web
